title: W3C CSS 2, Appendix D: “Default style sheet for HTML 4”
lede: The W3C’s informative sample style sheet that writes down how browsers render unstyled HTML.
summary: W3C CSS 2 Appendix D: body margin 8px, h1 2em, h2 1.5em, 40px indents, underlined links.

evidence.note: Read the appendix on 2026-10-02. The dates are the publication years of the CSS 2 and CSS 2.1 Recommendations as generally cited; the page itself was not checked for its date line.

styles.note: Documentation of the default rendering that the style keeps or restates.

context: The appendix lists `body { margin: 8px }`, `h1 { font-size: 2em; margin: .67em 0 }`, `h2 { font-size: 1.5em; margin: .75em 0 }`, `blockquote { margin-left: 40px; margin-right: 40px }`, and `:link, :visited { text-decoration: underline }`.
The current equivalent is the [Rendering section of the HTML Living Standard](ref:whatwg-html-rendering-defaults).
interpretation: The sizes here explain the narrow type scale in the [Brutalist web design](style:brutalist-web-design) fingerprint: the largest default heading is twice the body size.
borrow: Start from these values instead of a reset. Change only what the content needs.
